    Romanium Island¶

    "The dwarves found it first. They called it paradise. Then the ore ran out." — Dwarven historical record, Dwarvengor archives

    An island in the far north of Ge'or, northeast of Lung Continent across a vast stretch of violent sea, and northwest of the Demon Continent. Near the north pole. The island was the single richest source of Romanium on the planet — the perfect metal that fueled the Dwarf Era.

    The Dwarven Discovery¶

    During the Dwarf Era (5,499–4,500 BGD), dwarven explorers discovered the island and found it saturated with Romanium ore. For centuries, Romanium Island was the heart of the global economy. The ore extracted here was the highest quality on Ge'or — purer, stronger, and more abundant than any other source.

    The island was the foundation of dwarven prosperity. Gold, food, and silver were as cheap as water because Romanium from this island made everything else irrelevant.

    The Collapse¶

    Romanium is finite. The richest mine in the world is still a mine — and mines run dry.

    When the Romanium Island reserves began to deplete, the dwarven economy entered its slow, grinding collapse. It was not a sudden catastrophe. It was a generation-by-generation erosion — each year producing less ore, each year driving prices higher. The Golden War followed, as human horse-nomads from West and North Erisdar raided the weakening dwarven territories.

    The depletion of Romanium Island was the trigger for the end of the Dwarf Era. The rest of the collapse followed from this single geological fact: the perfect metal was running out.

    The Shadow Discovery¶

    The island was abandoned after the Dwarf Era. No one returned. The violent northern seas made it nearly unreachable, and there was nothing left worth mining.

    When the Shadows discovered the island approximately 597 years ago — around the time of the Great Divergence (Year 0) — they found something more valuable than ore: the ancient human silo left behind from the 157th Colony era, still intact, still functional.

    They also recovered the Glorious Alliance reactor core from the Formingar Ocean and brought it here. The integration of the core with the silo created the Armageddon neutron bomb — now housed at Eternal Paradise, the Shadow base on the island.

    Current State¶

    The island is now a Shadow military installation. No one on Ge'or knows it exists — except the Ironcloak, who have unverified intelligence fragments. The neutron bomb is nearly complete. The countdown has begun.
